record.question: What is the function of the TFT (Thin-Film Transistor) array in a digital mammography detector?
options: To focus the X-ray beam onto the breast.
To read out the electrical charges that form the digital image.
To compress the breast during the exposure.
record.explanation: Answer B: To read out the electrical charges that form the digital image.. The TFT array switches/reads detector pixel charge to digitize the image. Reference: https://www.radiologyinfo.org/en/info/mammo; https://www.dicomstandard.org/current. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
